versions.content: Programming language identifier limitations The restriction on the defaultValue and the value of a EcucLinkerSymbolDef and its subclass are the common programming language identifier limitations: start with a letter or a special character (sc) followed by upper- and lower-case letters, digits and special characters: identifier := (letter | sc) ( letter | digit | sc ) * where letter is [a-z] or [A-Z], sc is ( _ j . j $ j % ) and digit is [0-9].
